title: Better Fall Drop 2025 Panorama
body:
# Better Fall Drop 2025 Panorama
The current panorama for Fall Drop 2025 is pretty disappointing, being just a Copper Golem in a village.   
**This resource pack replaces the panorama with an improved version, featuring everything that was added in the drop.**
### Stuff:
Oxidised Lightning Rods  
Copper Chains  
Copper Chests  
Copper Lanterns  
Copper Golem  
Copper Golem Statue  
Copper Torch  
Copper Armor  
Copper Tools  
Copper Nugget  
Shelves
